title: thawing plate
text: thawing plate. I purchased this and was skeptical.  I purchased 2 types of these.  This one and one that was just the metal plate and didn't have a silicone edge with feet.  I definitely like this one the best, just because the little silicone strip (with nub feet) really help it to stay still on the counter and lifts it up just a tad - I think this helps with air flow under it (?)  I put on 2 frozen burger patties on it.  It will only fit 2 burgers, so it's not huge. If you have a large family or large amount of thawing meat to do, you'll need to purchase several.  The patties were about 3/8" thick.  They took 1 hour and were fully thawed.  I did flip them once, as suggested.  So, it works.  I would recommend this one with the silicone edge and nob feet.  HAND WASH ONLY - per their advice.  So I spray with an antibacterial spray (let it set for a few minutes) and then wash with soap and hot water - since we are talking about raw meat.  Do wish I could put in the dishwasher.  I think it's because of the nonstick like coating (?)  not sure.  Hope it lasts with careful care.  Time will tell, so I always add that I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful!
